f.title: Collect, submit and monitor adverse reaction data as prescribed by the rulebook
f.statement: To ensure the safe use of medicines in Montenegro, the marketing authorisation holder, health institutions, health professionals, clinical trial sponsors/applicants and legal entities involved in trading medicines (participants in the pharmacovigilance system) collect, submit and monitor data on adverse reactions to medicines for human use in the manner prescribed by this rulebook.

rows.actor: Participants in the pharmacovigilance system: MAH, clinical trial sponsor/applicant, legal entities trading medicines (also health institutions and professionals)
rows.quote: U cilju bezbjedne primjene ljekova u Crnoj Gori, nosilac dozvole za lijek, zdravstvena ustanova, zdravstveni radnik i naručilac, odnosno predlagač kliničkog ispitivanja, pravna lica koja učestvuju u prometu ljekova (u daljem tekstu: učesnici u sistemu farmakovigilance), prikupljaju, dostavljaju i prate podatke o neželjenim dejstvima ljekova, za upotrebu u humanoj medicini, na način propisan ovim pravilnikom.
rows.review_note: Review: general duty clause naming the actors; kept because it binds sponsors and distributors as well as MAHs. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For the purpose of the safe use of medicines in Montenegro, the marketing authorisation holder, the health institution, the health professional and the sponsor or proposer of a clinical trial, legal entities participating in the trade of medicines (hereinafter: participants in the pharmacovigilance system) collect, submit and monitor data on adverse reactions to medicines for use in human medicine, in the manner prescribed by this rulebook.

f.title: Treat a serious adverse event per the rulebook's seriousness criteria
f.statement: A serious adverse event related to taking a medicine is an adverse experience occurring during use of the medicine, for which a causal relationship has not been proven, that results in death, immediate threat to life, hospitalisation or prolongation of hospitalisation (if not needed before the medicine was used), permanent or significant damage or incapacity, congenital anomalies or disorders during breastfeeding, or another medically significant condition.

rows.actor: All participants in the pharmacovigilance system
rows.quote: ozbiljni neželjeni događaj u vezi sa uzimanjem lijeka je neželjeno iskustvo koje se dogodilo kod primjene lijeka i za koje nije dokazano da ima uzročnu vezu sa primjenom lijeka, a koje ima za posljedicu smrt, neposrednu životnu ugroženost, bolničko liječenje, odnosno produžetak bolničkog liječenja, ako za tim nije bilo potrebe prije upotrebe lijeka, trajno ili značajno oštećenje ili nesposobnost, kongenitalne anomalije ili poremećaje tokom dojenja ili drugo medicinski značajno stanje;
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets the seriousness criteria that drive expedited reporting (note: includes 'disorders during breastfeeding'). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: a serious adverse event related to taking a medicine is an adverse experience which occurred during use of the medicine and for which it has not been proven to have a causal relationship with the use of the medicine, and which results in death, immediate threat to life, hospital treatment or prolongation of hospital treatment if there was no need for it before use of the medicine, permanent or significant damage or incapacity, congenital anomalies or disorders during breastfeeding, or another medically significant condition;

f.title: Record solicited (stimulated) reports as clinical-study reports
f.statement: Stimulated (solicited) reporting covers adverse reaction reports obtained through organised data collection (clinical trials, registries, post-authorisation studies, surveys and similar); causality is assessed by the health professional or the MAH, and these reports are recorded as reports from clinical studies.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Podsticano prijavljivanje je svako prijavljivanje neželjenih dejstava dobijeno organizovanim prikupljanjem podataka (klinička ispitivanja, registri, ispitivanja lijeka nakon stavljanja lijeka u promet, ankete i sl.). Ove prijave se vode kao prijave iz kliničkih ispitivanja.
rows.review_note: Review: classification rule for solicited reports. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Stimulated reporting is any reporting of adverse reactions obtained through organised data collection (clinical trials, registries, post-authorisation studies of the medicine, surveys and the like). These reports are kept as reports from clinical trials.

f.title: Report suspected ADRs on the CIOMS I form or the Agency's ADR form
f.statement: Participants in the pharmacovigilance system report suspected adverse reactions on the CIOMS I adverse reaction report form or on the Agency's adverse reaction report form.
f.systems: CIOMS I form; Agency ADR form

rows.actor: Participants in the pharmacovigilance system (MAH, sponsor, distributors)
rows.quote: Učesnici u sistemu farmakovigilance, prijavljuju sumnju na neželjeno dejstvo lijeka na CIOMS I obrascu za prijavu neželjenog dejstva ili na prijavi neželjenog dejstva Agencije.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Participants in the pharmacovigilance system report a suspected adverse reaction to a medicine on the CIOMS I form for reporting an adverse reaction or on the Agency's adverse reaction report.

f.title: Ensure a valid report contains reporter, patient, reaction and suspect medicine
f.statement: To be considered valid, a report of a suspected adverse reaction to a medicine or vaccine must contain at least information on the reporter, the patient, the adverse reaction and the suspect medicine.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Participants in the pharmacovigilance system (MAH, sponsor)
rows.quote: Prijava sumnje na neželjeno dejstvo lijeka/vakcine da bi se smatrala validnom, mora sadržati najmanje podatke o: - izvještaču; - pacijentu; - ispoljenom neželjenom dejstvu lijeka; - suspektnom lijeku.
rows.review_note: Review: validity criteria; they also start the MAH's 15-day clock (Art 12). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: To be considered valid, a report of a suspected adverse reaction to a medicine/vaccine must contain at least information on: - the reporter; - the patient; - the adverse reaction that occurred; - the suspect medicine.

f.title: Obtain Agency approval of DHPC text and distribution plan before sending
f.statement: If a direct healthcare professional communication (letter to health professionals) is sent by the MAH, the text of the letter and its distribution plan must be approved in advance by the Agency.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Ukoliko pismo zdravstvenim radnicima upućuje nosilac dozvole za lijek, tekst pisma i plan distribucije pisma moraju biti prethodno odobreni od strane Agencije.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the letter to health professionals is sent by the marketing authorisation holder, the text of the letter and the distribution plan of the letter must be approved in advance by the Agency.

f.title: Keep DHPCs free of any promotion
f.statement: A letter to health professionals (DHPC) must not contain any form of advertising of the medicine.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Pismo zdravstvenim radnicima ne smije sadržati nijedan oblik oglašavanja lijeka.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The letter to health professionals must not contain any form of advertising of the medicine.

f.title: Establish, maintain, improve and manage a pharmacovigilance system in Montenegro
f.statement: For the safe use of medicines, the marketing authorisation holder establishes, maintains, improves and manages a pharmacovigilance system in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: U cilju bezbjedne primjene ljekova nosilac dozvole za lijek, uspostavlja, održava, unapređuje i upravlja sistemom farmakovigilance u Crnoj Gori.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For the purpose of the safe use of medicines, the marketing authorisation holder establishes, maintains, improves and manages the pharmacovigilance system in Montenegro.

f.title: Have the local PV responsible person monitor the safety profile of all authorised products
f.statement: The MAH's person responsible for pharmacovigilance monitors the safety profile and all safety issues relating to all medicines for which the MAH holds a marketing authorisation in Montenegro.

rows.actor: MAH's person responsible for pharmacovigilance in Montenegro
rows.quote: Odgovorno lice za farmakovigilancu nosioca dozvole za lijek prati bezbjednosni profil i sva bezbjednosna pitanja u vezi sa svim ljekovima za koje nosilac dozvole za lijek ima dozvolu za lijek u Crnoj Gori.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder's person responsible for pharmacovigilance monitors the safety profile and all safety issues related to all medicines for which the marketing authorisation holder holds a marketing authorisation in Montenegro.

f.title: Operate a system that makes all ADR information reported to the MAH, promoters or literature available
f.statement: To establish the pharmacovigilance system and take timely measures, the MAH establishes and manages a system ensuring the availability of information on all adverse reactions and events related to the use of the medicine, or suspicions thereof, that are reported to the MAH or to persons promoting medicines, or obtained from the published literature.
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: uspostavlja i upravlja sistemom koji obezbjeđuje dostupnost informacija o svim neželjenim dejstvima lijeka i događajima u vezi sa primjenom lijeka ili sumnji na njih koje su prijavljene nosiocu dozvole, licima koja vrše promociju ljekova ili koji su dobijeni iz objavljene literature;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: establishes and manages a system that ensures the availability of information on all adverse reactions to the medicine and events related to the use of the medicine, or suspicions thereof, which have been reported to the marketing authorisation holder or to persons promoting medicines, or which were obtained from the published literature;

f.title: Propose safety measures and give complete, timely answers to the Agency
f.statement: The MAH proposes to the Agency measures to be implemented for safety reasons and ensures complete and timely answers and the information needed to assess the safety of the medicine and the risk of its use.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: predlaže Agenciji mjere koje treba sprovesti iz bezbjednosnih razloga, obezbjeđuje potpune i blagovremene odgovore i potrebne informacije, radi procjene bezbjednosti lijeka i rizika vezanog uz njegovu primjenu;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: proposes to the Agency measures to be implemented for safety reasons, and ensures complete and timely answers and the necessary information for the assessment of the safety of the medicine and the risk associated with its use;

f.title: Report every domestic suspected ADR within 15 days of any employee's awareness
f.statement: The MAH submits to the Agency a report of every adverse reaction or suspicion thereof from the territory of Montenegro, including any suspected transmission of an infectious agent via a medicine, on the CIOMS I form or the Agency's form, immediately and at the latest 15 days from the day any employee of the MAH became aware of the minimum data (reporter, patient, reaction, suspect medicine, Art 7(3)). The day of awareness is day 0.
f.applicability: All suspected ADRs (serious and non-serious) occurring in Montenegro, including suspected transmission of infectious agents
f.systems: CIOMS I form; Agency ADR form

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.deadline: Immediately, at the latest 15 days from awareness of the minimum data by any MAH employee (day 0)
rows.quote: I obrascu ili obrascu Agencije odmah, a najkasnije 15 dana od dana saznanja podataka iz člana 7 stav 3 ovog pravilnika od strane bilo kojeg zaposlenog kod nosioca dozvole za lijek. Dan saznanja podataka iz člana 7 stav 3 ovog pravilnika smatra se danom 0 (nula).
rows.review_note: Review: quote starts after a page break in the captured text (the preceding words of the indent are on the previous page); note the rulebook applies 15 days to every domestic ADR (no seriousness split). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: [submits to the Agency a report on every adverse reaction ... from the territory of Montenegro ... on the CIOMS] I form or the Agency's form immediately, and at the latest 15 days from the day on which any employee of the marketing authorisation holder became aware of the data referred to in Article 7 paragraph 3 of this rulebook. The day of becoming aware of the data referred to in Article 7 paragraph 3 of this rulebook is considered day 0 (zero).

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana saznanja podataka iz člana 7 stav 3 ovog pravilnika od strane bilo kojeg zaposlenog kod nosioca dozvole za lijek
deadline_rule.applies_to: all suspected ADRs from Montenegro, serious and non-serious, incl. suspected transmission of infectious agents

f.title: Send follow-up information within 15 days, day 0 being receipt of the new information
f.statement: The same 15-day period applies to sending additional (follow-up) information; day 0 is the day on which the new information on the adverse reaction became known.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.deadline: 15 days from the day the new information became known (day 0)
rows.quote: Isti vremenski period iz stava 3 alineje 3 ovog člana primjenjuje se za slanje dodatnih informacija, te se danom 0 (nula) smatra dan kada su se saznale nove informacije o neželjenom dejstvu;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The same time period referred to in paragraph 3 indent 3 of this Article applies to sending additional information, and day 0 (zero) is considered the day on which new information on the adverse reaction became known;

deadline_rule.clock_start: dan kada su se saznale nove informacije o neželjenom dejstvu
deadline_rule.applies_to: follow-up information on domestic ADR reports

f.title: On request, submit serious unexpected ADRs from the EU or third countries within 15 days
f.statement: At the Agency's request, the MAH submits reports of suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions, or suspected transmission of infectious agents via a medicine, from EU countries or third countries, on the CIOMS I form, immediately and at the latest 15 days from receipt of the request.
f.applicability: Serious unexpected ADRs and suspected transmission of infectious agents occurring outside Montenegro

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.deadline: Immediately, at the latest 15 days from receipt of the Agency's request
rows.quote: dostavlja na zahtjev Agencije prijave sumnje na ozbiljna i neočekivana neželjena dejstva lijeka ili na prenošenje infektivnih agenasa putem nekog lijeka, sa teritorije zemalja Evropske unije, odnosno neke treće zemlje, u skladu sa zakonom, na CIOMS I obrascu, odmah, a najkasnije 15 dana od dana prijema zahtjeva;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submits, at the request of the Agency, reports of suspected serious and unexpected adverse reactions to a medicine or of transmission of infectious agents via a medicine, from the territory of European Union countries or a third country, in accordance with the law, on the CIOMS I form, immediately, and at the latest 15 days from the day of receipt of the request;

deadline_rule.applies_to: serious unexpected ADRs from the EU or third countries, on Agency request

f.title: Report ADRs from post-authorisation non-interventional studies the MAH sponsors
f.statement: The MAH reports, in line with the domestic and foreign reporting rules of Article 12(3) indents 3 and 4, suspected adverse reactions occurring during a post-authorisation non-interventional study of the medicine for which the MAH is the study proposer.
f.applicability: Post-authorisation non-interventional studies proposed (sponsored) by the MAH
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: prijavljuje u skladu sa stavom 3 al. 3 i 4 ovog člana sumnju na neželjena dejstva ispoljena u toku postmarketinškog neintervencijskog kliničkog ispitivanja lijeka, za koje je nosilac dozvole predlagač kliničkog ispitivanja;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: reports, in accordance with paragraph 3 indents 3 and 4 of this Article, suspected adverse reactions which occurred during a post-authorisation non-interventional clinical study of the medicine for which the marketing authorisation holder is the proposer of the study;

f.title: Submit PSURs, RMPs, DDPS, PSMF and NIS results reports to the Agency
f.statement: The MAH submits to the Agency the following safety documents: PSUR, RMP, DDPS, PSMF, the report on the results of non-interventional clinical studies of the medicine and other documents containing safety information.
f.processes: Submission operations; Aggregate reporting; PSMF management

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: dostavlja Agenciji sljedeća dokumenta o bezbjednosti: PSUR, RMP, DDPS, PSMF, izvještaj o rezultatima neintervencijskog kliničkog ispitivanja lijeka i druga dokumenta koja sadrže informacije o bezbjednosti;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submits to the Agency the following safety documents: PSUR, RMP, DDPS, PSMF, the report on the results of a non-interventional clinical study of the medicine and other documents containing safety information;

f.title: Answer all Agency questions and provide benefit-risk, sales and prescription data
f.statement: The MAH ensures complete and timely answers to all of the Agency's questions and submits all information related to the benefit-risk assessment of the medicine, as well as information on the volume of sales or prescriptions in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: obezbjeđuje potpune i blagovremene odgovore na sva pitanja Agencije i dostavlja Agenciji sve informacije vezane za procjenu odnosa koristi i rizika lijeka, kao i informacije o obimu prodaje ili propisivanja ljekova na teritoriji Crne Gore.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: ensures complete and timely answers to all questions of the Agency and submits to the Agency all information related to the assessment of the benefit-risk balance of the medicine, as well as information on the volume of sales or prescription of medicines in the territory of Montenegro.

f.title: Code adverse reactions with MedDRA
f.statement: MedDRA is used when processing data on adverse reactions reported under Article 12(3) indents 3, 4 and 5 (domestic, foreign and study-derived reports).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Prilikom obrade podataka o ispoljenim neželjenim dejstvima lijeka iz stava 3 al. 3, 4 i 5 ovog člana, koristi se MEDDRA.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: When processing data on adverse reactions referred to in paragraph 3 indents 3, 4 and 5 of this Article, MedDRA is used.

f.title: Treat INN-only reports as concerning the MAH's own product and report them
f.statement: If the MAH receives a report naming only the generic name (INN) of the suspect medicine, it must assume that the report concerns the medicine for whose safe use it is responsible and is obliged to submit the report to the Agency in accordance with Article 12(3) indents 3, 4 and 5.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: U slučaju da je nosilac dozvole primio prijavu samo pod generičkim imenom suspektnog lijeka (INN), mora pretpostaviti da se radi o lijeku za čiju je bezbjednu primjenu odgovoran i obavezan je da dostavi prijavu Agenciji u skladu sa stavom 3 al. 3,4 i 5 ovog člana.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the marketing authorisation holder has received a report only under the generic name of the suspect medicine (INN), it must assume that it concerns the medicine for whose safe use it is responsible and is obliged to submit the report to the Agency in accordance with paragraph 3 indents 3, 4 and 5 of this Article.

f.title: Protect the identity of reporting health professionals
f.statement: The MAH protects the identity of the health professional who reported an adverse reaction: it provides the reporter's data only to the Agency and must not disclose them to third parties, in accordance with applicable regulations.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole štiti identitet zdravstvenog radnika koji je izvještač o neželjenom dejstvu lijeka, odnosno da podatke o njemu dostavlja isključivo Agenciji i ne smije ih otkrivati trećim licima, u skladu sa važećim propisima.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder protects the identity of the health professional who is the reporter of the adverse reaction to the medicine, i.e. it submits data on him exclusively to the Agency and must not disclose them to third parties, in accordance with the applicable regulations.

f.title: Collect and monitor safety data in special situations (pregnancy, overdose, misuse, errors and others)
f.statement: The MAH specifically collects and monitors data relevant to the benefit-risk assessment in these cases: from submission of the MA application until the MA is granted; after temporary suspension or withdrawal from the market; use during pregnancy; use during breastfeeding; use in children and the elderly; lack of efficacy; transmission of infectious agents; overdose, abuse and unapproved (off-label) use; and medication errors.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek posebno prikuplja i prati podatke važne za procjenu odnosa koristi i rizika lijeka u sljedećim slučajevima:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the list of nine situations follows in the source. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder specifically collects and monitors data important for the assessment of the benefit-risk balance of the medicine in the following cases:

f.title: Report special-situation cases with an ADR as ICSRs; send those without an ADR in the PSUR or on request
f.statement: If a special-situation case (Art 14(1)) results in a suspected adverse reaction, the MAH reports it to the Agency under Article 12. If it does not, the MAH submits the collected data to the Agency in the PSUR or immediately at the Agency's request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Ako slučaj primjene lijeka iz stava 1 ovog člana nema za posljedicu sumnju na neželjeno dejstvo lijeka, nosilac dozvole za lijek prikupljene podatke dostavlja Agenciji u formi periodičnog izvještaja o bezbjednosti lijeka ili na zahtjev Agencije odmah.
rows.review_note: Review: quote proves the no-ADR branch; the ADR branch (report under Art 12) is the preceding sentence. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the case of use of the medicine referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article does not result in a suspected adverse reaction, the marketing authorisation holder submits the collected data to the Agency in the form of a periodic safety update report or immediately at the request of the Agency.

f.title: Follow Agency case-specific reporting instructions when public health is threatened
f.statement: Where public health is threatened, the manner of reporting adverse reactions may be changed according to guidance and recommendations issued by the Agency for individual cases, which the MAH must follow.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: U slučajevima u kojima je ugroženo javno zdravlje način prijavljivanja neželjenih dejstava može biti promijenjen po smjernicama i preporukama koje daje Agencija za pojedinačne slučajeve, kojih se nosilac dozvole mora pridržavati.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: In cases in which public health is threatened, the manner of reporting adverse reactions may be changed according to guidelines and recommendations given by the Agency for individual cases, which the marketing authorisation holder must comply with.

f.title: Submit a risk management plan describing the risk management system
f.statement: The MAH submits to the Agency a risk management plan (RMP) describing the risk management system.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Nosilac dozvole za lijek dostavlja Agenciji plan upravljanja rizikom - Risk Management Plan (u daljem tekstu: RMP) kojim se opisuje sistem upravljanja rizikom.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder submits to the Agency a Risk Management Plan (hereinafter: RMP) describing the risk management system.

f.title: Prepare and distribute additional risk minimisation materials to HCPs and patients
f.statement: When the RMP provides for additional pharmacovigilance/risk minimisation activities (e.g. educational material, patient card), the MAH is obliged to prepare the documentation and deliver it to health professionals or patients. The MAH is responsible for the accuracy and currency of the data.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Kada su RMP predviđene dodatne farmakovigilantne aktivnosti u cilju minimizacije rizika od primjene lijeka (npr. edukativni materijal, kartica za pacijenta), nosilac dozvole je u obavezi da pripremi dokumentaciju i dostavi je zdravstvenim radnicima odnosno pacijentima. Nosilac dozvole je odgovoran za tačnost i ažurnost podataka.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: When the RMP provides for additional pharmacovigilance activities to minimise the risk of use of the medicine (e.g. educational material, patient card), the marketing authorisation holder is obliged to prepare the documentation and deliver it to health professionals or patients. The marketing authorisation holder is responsible for the accuracy and currency of the data.

f.title: Submit PSURs on request immediately or as regular reports per GVP Module VII
f.statement: The MAH submits to the Agency the PSUR, containing comprehensive post-marketing safety information with an expert benefit-risk evaluation, immediately at the Agency's request or as regular reports in accordance with the EMA Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices (GVP) Module VII - Periodic safety update report.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.deadline: Immediately on request; otherwise per GVP Module VII periodicity
rows.quote:
Nosilac dozvole za lijek dostavlja Agenciji PSUR, koji sadrži sveobuhvatne informacije o bezbjednosti lijeka, koje su prikupljene u vremenskom periodu nakon stavljanja lijeka u promet, sa stručnom procjenom odnosa koristi i rizika prilikom njegove primjene, na zahtjev Agencije odmah, ili u obliku redovnih izvještaja, u skladu sa smjernicama Evropske agencije za ljekove o dobroj praksi u farmakovigilanci (Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices-
GVP, Module VII - Periodic safety update report).
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder submits to the Agency the PSUR, which contains comprehensive information on the safety of the medicine collected in the period after the medicine was placed on the market, with an expert assessment of the benefit-risk balance of its use, immediately at the request of the Agency, or in the form of regular reports, in accordance with the European Medicines Agency guidelines on good pharmacovigilance practices (Guideline on good pharmacovigilance practices - GVP, Module VII - Periodic safety update report).

f.title: Accompany each PSUR with a QPPV-signed cover letter stating product, period and CCSI-SmPC differences
f.statement: The MAH submits a cover letter with the PSUR containing: the medicine(s) concerned (name, pharmaceutical form, strength, MA number); the period covered; and the main differences between the CCSI and the SmPC approved for Montenegro. The cover letter must be signed by the MAH's person responsible for pharmacovigilance.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Uz PSUR nosilac dozvole dostavlja i propratno pismo.
data_elements: product name, form, strength, MA number
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the opening sentence; content list and the signature duty ('Propratno pismo mora biti potpisano od strane odgovornog lica za farmakovigilancu') follow in the same article. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Together with the PSUR the marketing authorisation holder also submits a cover letter.

f.title: Include an expert benefit-risk evaluation and needed SmPC, PL or RMP changes in the PSUR
f.statement: The PSUR must contain an expert assessment of the risk-benefit balance of the medicine with regard to information collected during the reporting period, in light of previous safety knowledge, as well as the need for changes to the SmPC, the package leaflet or the RMP.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: PSUR mora da sadrži i stručnu procjenu odnosa rizika i koristi određenog lijeka u odnosu na informacije prikupljene tokom izvještajnog perioda, u skladu sa prethodnim saznanjima o bezbjednosti lijeka, kao i potrebu izmjena u sažetku karakteristika lijeka, uputstvu za lijek, ili RMP.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The PSUR must also contain an expert assessment of the risk-benefit balance of the particular medicine in relation to the information collected during the reporting period, in accordance with previous knowledge on the safety of the medicine, as well as the need for changes to the summary of product characteristics, the package leaflet or the RMP.

f.title: Cover the period from the previous PSUR to the request date in an on-request PSUR
f.statement: If the PSUR is submitted at the Agency's request, it contains data for the period from the previously submitted report up to the date of the Agency's request.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Montenegro
rows.quote: Ako se PSUR predaje na osnovu zahtjeva Agencije, on sadrži podatke za period od prethodno predatog izvještaja do dana zahtjeva Agencije.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the PSUR is submitted on the basis of a request of the Agency, it contains data for the period from the previously submitted report until the day of the Agency's request.

f.title: Distributors: provide all benefit-risk relevant data they hold
f.statement: All legal entities involved in the trade of medicines submit to the Agency all data in their possession that are relevant to the benefit-risk assessment of medicines on the market.
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.actor: Legal entities involved in the trade of medicines (wholesalers, distributors, MAHs)
rows.quote: Sva pravna lica koja učestvuju u prometu ljekova dostavljaju Agenciji sve podatke koje imaju u posjedu, a koji su važni za procjenu odnosa koristi i rizika za ljekove koji su na tržištu.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: All legal entities participating in the trade of medicines submit to the Agency all data in their possession which are important for the assessment of the benefit-risk balance of medicines on the market.

f.title: Notify the Agency in a timely manner of serious unexpected reactions during a trial
f.statement: The clinical trial sponsor submits timely notification to the Agency of any serious and unexpected adverse reaction occurring during the conduct of a clinical trial.
f.clause: III. Farmakovigilanca u kliničkom ispitivanju lijeka, Član 21

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Naručilac kliničkog ispitivanja (u daljem tekstu: sponzor) dostavlja blagovremeno obavještenje Agenciji u slučaju ozbiljnog i neočekivanog neželjenog dejstva u toku sprovođenja kliničkog ispitivanja lijeka.
rows.location: III. Farmakovigilanca u kliničkom ispitivanju lijeka, Član 21
rows.review_note: Review: general duty; deadlines in Art 23. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor of the clinical trial (hereinafter: sponsor) submits a timely notification to the Agency in the case of a serious and unexpected adverse reaction during the conduct of the clinical trial of the medicine.

f.title: Investigators: report all serious adverse events to the sponsor immediately
f.statement: A health professional acting as investigator in a clinical trial immediately reports all serious adverse reactions/adverse events to the sponsor, except those for which this is not required by the clinical trial protocol or the Investigator's Brochure.
f.exceptions: Events for which immediate reporting is not required by the protocol or the Investigator's Brochure.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: Investigator (health professional participating in the clinical trial)
rows.quote: Zdravstveni radnik koji učestvuje u kliničkom ispitivanju u svojstvu istraživača, sva ozbiljna neželjena dejstva/neželjene događaje odmah prijavljuje sponzoru, osim onih za koje se to ne zahtijeva Protokolom kliničkog ispitivanja ili Brošurom za istraživače.
rows.review_note: Review: investigator duty kept because the sponsor's SAE intake process must receive it. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: A health professional who participates in a clinical trial as an investigator immediately reports all serious adverse reactions/adverse events to the sponsor, except those for which this is not required by the clinical trial protocol or the Investigator's Brochure.

f.title: Assess investigator reports and inform investigators, ethics committee and Agency of new risks
f.statement: The sponsor assesses the investigators' SAE reports and without delay informs all investigators, the Ethics Committee and the Agency of all findings that could adversely affect the health of trial subjects, the conduct of the trial, or lead to suspension of the clinical trial.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Sponzor vrši procjenu prijava iz stava 2 ovog člana i bez odlaganja obavještava sve istraživače, Etički komitet i Agenciju o svim saznanjima koja bi mogla štetno da utiču na zdravlje ispitanika, sprovođenje ispitivanja ili na obustavljanje sprovođenja kliničkog ispitivanja.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor assesses the reports referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article and without delay informs all investigators, the Ethics Committee and the Agency of all findings that could adversely affect the health of trial subjects, the conduct of the trial or the suspension of the conduct of the clinical trial.

f.title: Keep detailed records of all reported AEs and assess seriousness, causality and expectedness
f.statement: The sponsor keeps detailed records of all adverse reactions/adverse events reported to it by investigators and assesses their seriousness, causal relationship and expectedness.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Sponzor vodi detaljnu evidenciju o svim neželjenim dejstvima/neželjenim događajima koje mu je prijavio istraživač i vrši procjenu njihove ozbiljnosti, uzročno-posljedične povezanosti i očekivanosti.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor keeps detailed records of all adverse reactions/adverse events reported to it by the investigator and assesses their seriousness, causal relationship and expectedness.

f.title: Do not downgrade the investigator's causality; report both assessments when they differ
f.statement: The sponsor must not downgrade the causality assessed by the investigator. If the sponsor disagrees with the investigator's causality assessment, both assessments must be given in the case report submitted to the Agency.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Sponzor ne smije da umanji stepen uzročno-posljedične povezanosti koji je procijenio istraživač. Ako se sponzor ne slaže sa procjenom uzročno-posljedične povezanosti koju je izvršio istraživač, u prijavi slučaja koja se dostavlja Agenciji treba navesti obje procjene.
rows.review_note: Review: first sentence 'ne smije' = must not; second 'treba' read with it as part of one mandatory rule. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor must not reduce the degree of causal relationship assessed by the investigator. If the sponsor does not agree with the assessment of the causal relationship made by the investigator, both assessments should be stated in the case report submitted to the Agency.

f.title: Report to the Agency SUSARs, increased-frequency expected SARs, serious hazards and post-study SUSARs from Montenegro
f.statement: The sponsor reports to the Agency adverse reactions that occurred in Montenegro: (1) serious unexpected adverse reactions during the trial; (2) serious expected adverse reactions with a clinically significant increased frequency; (3) serious hazards for patients during the trial (e.g. lack of efficacy in life-threatening disease); (4) serious unexpected reactions in a patient after the end of the study reported by the investigator; (5) serious unexpected reactions to a medicine used as active control, of which it also informs the MAH in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Sponzor kliničkog ispitivanja prijavljuje Agenciji neželjena dejstva koja su se ispoljila na teritoriji Crne Gore i to:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the five categories follow in the source. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor of the clinical trial reports to the Agency adverse reactions which occurred in the territory of Montenegro, namely:

f.title: Submit trial safety reports directly or through a legal representative seated in Montenegro
f.statement: The sponsor submits the adverse reactions referred to in Article 22(1) to the Agency directly if it has its seat in Montenegro, or otherwise through its legal representative seated in Montenegro.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Sponzor dostavlja Agenciji neželjena dejstva iz stava 1 ovog člana direktno ukoliko ima sjedište u Crnoj Gori, odnosno preko svog pravnog zastupnika sa sjedištem u Crnoj Gori.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor submits the adverse reactions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article to the Agency directly if it has its seat in Montenegro, or through its legal representative with a seat in Montenegro.

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 days of first knowledge
f.statement: Serious unexpected adverse reactions during a clinical trial that are fatal or life-threatening are reported by the sponsor to the Agency immediately, and at the latest seven days from the day the sponsor first became aware (initial report).

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.deadline: Immediately, at the latest 7 days from first knowledge
rows.quote: Ozbiljna, neočekivana neželjena dejstva lijeka ispoljena u toku kliničkog ispitivanja lijeka koja su fatalna ili ugrožavaju život, sponzor prijavljuje Agenciji odmah, a najkasnije sedam dana od dana kada je došao do prvog saznanja (inicijalna prijava).
rows.review_note: Review: origin domestic because Art 22 limits expedited reporting to events in Montenegro. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Serious, unexpected adverse reactions to a medicine which occurred during a clinical trial and which are fatal or life-threatening are reported by the sponsor to the Agency immediately, and at the latest seven days from the day it first became aware (initial report).

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana kada je došao do prvog saznanja

f.title: Send follow-up information on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 8 days of the initial report
f.statement: The sponsor submits additional information for the fatal/life-threatening SUSAR report at the latest within eight days of the day the first (initial) report was submitted.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.deadline: At the latest 8 days from submission of the initial report
rows.quote: Sponzor dostavlja Agenciji dodatne informacije za prijavu iz stava 1 ovog člana, najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana dostavljanja prve, odnosno inicijalne prijave.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor submits to the Agency additional information for the report referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article at the latest within eight days from the day of submission of the first, i.e. initial, report.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana dostavljanja prve, odnosno inicijalne prijave
deadline_rule.applies_to: follow-up of fatal or life-threatening SUSARs

f.title: Report other SUSARs within 15 days and send follow-ups as information becomes available
f.statement: Serious unexpected adverse reactions that are not fatal and not life-threatening are reported by the sponsor to the Agency at the latest within 15 days of the day the sponsor was first informed (initial report); a subsequent report follows as soon as additional information becomes available.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.deadline: At the latest 15 days from first notification; follow-up as soon as available
rows.quote: Prijave ozbiljnih, neočekivanih neželjenih dejstava lijeka koja nijesu fatalna i ne ugrožavaju život, sponzor dostavlja Agenciji najkasnije u roku od 15 dana od dana kada je prvi put obaviješten o ovom neželjenom dejstvu (inicijalna prijava), a zatim dostavlja narednu prijavu čim dodatne informacije budu dostupne.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Reports of serious, unexpected adverse reactions to a medicine which are not fatal and are not life-threatening are submitted by the sponsor to the Agency at the latest within 15 days from the day it was first informed of this adverse reaction (initial report), and it then submits a subsequent report as soon as additional information becomes available.

deadline_rule.clock_start: od dana kada je prvi put obaviješten o ovom neželjenom dejstvu

f.title: Submit a line listing of SUSARs from all trial countries at least every six months
f.statement: The sponsor submits to the Agency a list of all suspected serious unexpected adverse reactions (SUSARs) from all countries in which the same clinical trial is being conducted, at least once every six months, and more often at the Agency's request.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.deadline: At least every six months (more often on request)
rows.quote: listu svih sumnji na ozbiljna, neočekivana neželjena dejstva lijeka (u daljem tekstu: SUSAR) iz svih država u kojima se sprovodi isto kliničko ispitivanje lijeka, najmanje jednom u šest mjeseci, a na zahtjev Agencije i češće;
rows.review_note: Review: periodic six-monthly duty with no stated clock start, so no deadline_rule. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: a list of all suspected serious, unexpected adverse reactions to the medicine (hereinafter: SUSAR) from all countries in which the same clinical trial of the medicine is conducted, at least once every six months, and more often at the request of the Agency;

f.title: Submit a DSUR at least annually and a final safety report after the trial ends
f.statement: The sponsor submits a Development Safety Update Report (DSUR) at least once a year and, after the end of the trial, a final safety report on the investigational medicine.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.deadline: At least annually; final report after the end of the trial
rows.quote: izvještaj o bezbjednosti lijeka u razvoju (DSUR) najmanje jednom godišnje, a nakon završetka ispitivanja završni izvještaj o bezbjednosti ispitivanog lijeka.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: the development safety update report (DSUR) at least once a year, and after the end of the trial a final report on the safety of the investigational medicine.

f.title: Submit individual SUSARs from other trial countries only on Agency request
f.statement: By way of exception to the line-listing duty, individual SUSARs from all countries in which the same clinical trial is conducted are submitted to the Agency only at its request.
f.exceptions: Applies to individual foreign SUSAR reports; line listings remain mandatory.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Izuzetno od stava 1 ovog člana, pojedinačni SUSAR iz svih država u kojima se sprovodi isto kliničko ispitivanje lijeka dostavlja se Agenciji samo na njen zahtjev.
rows.review_note: Review: level Permitted (individual foreign cases only on request). Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: By way of exception to paragraph 1 of this Article, an individual SUSAR from all countries in which the same clinical trial of the medicine is conducted is submitted to the Agency only at its request.

f.title: Include minimum data in the initial SUSAR report
f.statement: The SUSAR report (Art 23) contains at least: the patient (subject) identification code; the investigational medicine suspected of causing the reaction; the adverse reaction assessed as serious and unexpected; the clinical trial identifier; and the name and address of the sponsor.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Prijava iz člana 23 ovog pravilnika, sadrži najmanje sljedeće podatke:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the five data items follow. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The report referred to in Article 23 of this rulebook contains at least the following data:

f.title: Collect missing information from investigators and submit a complete follow-up SUSAR report
f.statement: Where Art 23 information is incomplete, the sponsor collects from the investigator all relevant data needed for causality assessment and submits them in a subsequent report containing: trial data (protocol number, phase and purpose, investigational medicine, indication, approval number); subject data (initials, code, age, sex, weight, height, country); suspect medicine data (INN or trade name, batch, indication, form and strength, dosing, route, start/stop dates and times); the adverse reactions (Art 27); concomitant medicines including OTC, traditional and homeopathic medicines and dietary products; and the reporter (name, telephone, occupation, signature, date).

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: U slučaju nepotpunih informacija iz člana 23 ovog pravilnika, sponzor prikuplja od istraživača sve relevantne podatke koji su potrebni za procjenu uzročno-posljedične povezanosti i dostavlja ih putem naredne prijave iz člana 23 ovog pravilnika.
data_elements: subject initials, age, sex, weight, height
rows.review_note: Review: content list summarised from the article's points 1-6. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: In the case of incomplete information referred to in Article 23 of this rulebook, the sponsor collects from the investigator all relevant data necessary for the assessment of the causal relationship and submits them through a subsequent report referred to in Article 23 of this rulebook.

f.title: Describe adverse reactions in detail, with ICD-10 diagnoses, dates, dechallenge/rechallenge and outcome
f.statement: The adverse reaction data in the follow-up report contain: a detailed description of all reactions (signs and symptoms), seriousness and the criteria for seriousness, with specific ICD-10 diagnoses where possible; start and stop dates and times; measures and treatment given; dechallenge and rechallenge information; outcome (death with cause and causality comment and post-mortem findings where available, permanent damage, hospitalisation, life threat or recovery); and other relevant information (history, laboratory results, allergies, pregnancy, drug or alcohol abuse, family history).

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Podaci o neželjenim dejstvima iz člana 26 tačka 4 ovog pravilnika, sadrže:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; list summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The data on adverse reactions referred to in Article 26 point 4 of this rulebook contain:

f.title: Report SUSARs to the Agency on the CIOMS I form
f.statement: The sponsor reports serious, unexpected adverse reactions to the Agency by submitting the standardised international reporting form (CIOMS I form).

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: Izvještavanje Agencije o ozbiljnim, neočekivanim neželjenim dejstvima lijeka, sponzor obavlja dostavljanjem standardizovanog međunarodnog obrasca za prijavu (CIOMS -I obrazac).
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor reports serious, unexpected adverse reactions to the medicine to the Agency by submitting the standardised international reporting form (CIOMS-I form).

f.title: Unblind only the affected subject before reporting a possibly related serious unexpected reaction
f.statement: For a serious unexpected adverse reaction that may be causally related to the investigational medicine, the sponsor breaks the treatment code before reporting to the Agency, only for the subject concerned. If the subject received the investigational medicine or placebo, the suspected SUSAR is reported to the Agency. If the subject received the active control, expectedness is re-assessed against the SmPC specified in the protocol and, if unexpected, the reaction is reported to the Agency.

rows.actor: Sponsor (naručilac) of a clinical trial in Montenegro
rows.quote: U slučaju ozbiljnog, neočekivanog neželjenog dejstva lijeka koje može biti u uzročno-posljedičnoj vezi sa ispitivanim lijekom, prije izvještavanja Agencije, sponzor otkriva šifru terapije i to samo za ispitanika kod kojeg se ispoljilo neželjeno dejstvo.
rows.review_note: Review: placebo/active-comparator handling summarised from the second paragraph of the same article. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: In the case of a serious, unexpected adverse reaction to a medicine which may be causally related to the investigational medicine, before reporting to the Agency, the sponsor breaks the treatment code, and only for the subject in whom the adverse reaction occurred.

dates.title: Montenegro ADR rulebook (Sl. list CG 46/14): enters into force
dates.scope: MAHs, clinical trial sponsors, distributors, health institutions and professionals in Montenegro
dates.quote: Ovaj pravilnik stupa na snagu osmog dana od dana objavljivanja u "Službenom listu Crne Gore".
dates.quote_en: This rulebook enters into force on the eighth day from the day of publication in the Official Gazette of Montenegro.
dates.timing_note: Published in Sl. list CG 46/14 of 31.10.2014; 2014-10-31 + 8 days = 2014-11-08 (eighth day from publication, counting the publication day as day 0).
